compute_radial_distribution: compute the radial distribution function g(r) for particle coordinates in a periodic box
compute_pairwise_distances_pbc: compute pairwise distance vectors between particles obeying periodic boundary conditions in a simulation box
estimate_free_energy_fep: estimate the free energy difference using the Free Energy Perturbation estimator from forward work values
compute_effective_sample_size: compute the effective sample size ESS percentage from model and target log probabilities
compute_importance_sampling_estimate: compute an importance sampling weighted estimate of the mean value of data using model and target log probabilities
